$comment: Intended visual changes, allowed only while visual-reference.sha is the reference below; see lib/approvals.ts.

changes.reason: Privacy policy: the Discord login's data (and the profile it creates), friend codes and the 7-day session cookie are described; plus the header's Login button.
Logged-out profile page: 'Login with Discord to open your player profile.' (profiles are created at login, not linked by staff); plus the header's Login button.
A Discord member without a player profile gets a new, empty one at login instead of the 'No Linked Player Profile' notice.

Discord login: while logged out, the header shows a Login button (person icon, 'Login' on wide screens) where the signed-in account button sits, because the fixtures simulate an available login. Measured: only that box differs (x 1341-1425, y 12-53 at 1440px). On /player-card only the header behind the card changes; the card is identical.
